_comment: SAMPLE DATA for offline demos only. Fictional Wiz issues modelled on public CVEs. Not from any real tenant.

findings.scenario: A - new critical finding, no Wiz repo mapping (Bitbucket finds it), no existing ticket -> CREATE NEW
findings.title: log4j-core 2.14.1 vulnerable to Log4Shell on internet-facing xena-api
findings.toxicCombination: Internet-exposed pod with known-exploited RCE and IAM role that can read S3 bucket xena-prod-exports

code._note: No Wiz Code mapping for this image; bitbucket-repo-investigator resolves it from the image name and app tag

findings.wizRemediation: Upgrade org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core to 2.17.1 or later. As interim mitigation remove JndiLookup class from the classpath.

findings.scenario: B - critical finding already tracked -> UPDATE EXISTING XENA-1311
findings.title: OpenSSH 9.3p1 regreSSHion RCE on xena bastion host
findings.wizRemediation: Upgrade openssh-server to 9.8p1 or later, or set LoginGraceTime 0 as interim mitigation. Restrict SSH ingress.

findings.scenario: C - HIGH severity -> out of PoC scope
findings.title: jackson-databind deserialization issue in xena-insights
